changelog: React Bits Prompt Bar Redesign: Pixel-perfect recreation of reactbits.dev/micro/prompt-bar with dark zinc container, 'Ask anything...' placeholder, and elegant rounded controls
Actions Popover Menu: Smooth floating panel with quick actions for Photos & Files, Web Search (@web), Workspace Files (@), Slash Commands (/), and Voice Notes
Interactive Reasoning Effort Slider: Smooth stepped slider popover (Off, Low, Med, High) with animated pill thumb and direct preference synchronization, plus quick access to advanced token settings
Model Picker & State-Aware Controls: Compact model pill with quota indicator, integrated dictation/voice toggle, and morphing squircle Send/Stop button
